source.flashinfer_reuse: Only the unchanged FlashInfer Graph reference is reused. Its page=64 wrapper, input SHA256, Graph capture/fallback, GPU hygiene, nsys hashes and profile/clean token identity are revalidated. No FlashInfer eager operator arm is claimed.

protocol.speedup: reference time / treatment time; >1 means treatment faster
protocol.zero_stage_speedup: null only when both arms have zero standalone stage time; eager fused candidate is included in l1_topk_ms and has no separate candidate_ms
protocol.operator_measurement: separate nsys kernel trace; not clean TPOT
protocol.clean_tpot: separate process without nsys or torch.profiler; full decode TPOT
protocol.targeted_eager_rerun: tail_skip_eager and full_skip_eager use the eager-region-fastpath source. The delta is confined to not-capturing host launch-plan matching; Graph, uniform-region acceptance and no-skip receipts are retained with their original source identity and checked explicitly.

region_kernel_audit.interpretation: calls are per layer for the whole batch, not per request; generic=non-skip or mixed-batch, near_only=skip-far, far_only=skip-near; uniform both-skip contributes zero to every active selector entry
